To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the 3-point correlator of Δ-BMN operator with 3 scalar operators is non-zero and that the vertex-correlators duality equation is valid at the 3 impurities level for the supergravity and for the string modes.
we have calculated 3-point functions of Δ-BNM operators with 3 impurites, and have tested the duality of these correlators to string theory.
we have calculated the three-point function of Δ-BMN scalar operators in N=4 SYM, and that the results agree with the predictions of the vertex correlator duality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the BMN limit of the AdS5 × S5 superstring.
the study of correlation functions of composite operators in N = 4 supersymetric Yang-Mills theory in the large N limit.
the study of correlation functions of local operators in N=4 SYM theory in 4D.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the duality equation of the vertex correlator type is verified at the 3-scalar impurites level.
the duality holds at all orders in perturbation theory in the pp wave limit.
we have verified the duality equation at the 3-point level for supergravity modes and for stringy modes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the duality is correct, but that there are subtleties.
the duality equation holds at the 3-point correlator level for any number of scalar impurites, but not for the general 3-point correlatores of the Δ-BMN operators.
the vertex-correlators are in perfect agreement with supergravity and string modes at the 3-point level, but the 3-string vertices are in perfect agreement only for the supergravity sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to test the vertex-correlators duality, it is enough to consider only the Δ-BMN operators, i.e. the operators that are dual to string modes.
the vertex-correlater duality holds at least for the simplest 3-point correlator of Δ-BMN vertex operators.
the vertex-correlators duality is an important tool in the study of the pp-wave/SYm duality.
